subject: Extract the whole reflectance bands as continuous manner

messages.author: 52dae4b8e780ed03
messages.subject: Extract the whole reflectance bands as continuous manner
parts:
So far I could generate the various vegetation indices for our maize plots thanks to Fieldimage R. I put one example below. Thank you ! 

Vegetation indices are just the ratios for plot. But I would like to extract the whole reflected bands (not ratio) as continuous scale for each row plots. Is this possible ?

Thanks,
Alper

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Extract the whole reflectance bands as continuous manner
parts:
Hi Alper,

That's very cool, thanks for sharing...!!!

Do you want to extract the RGB band average per plot (Blue, Green, and Red)? 

Did you try to use the entire object during the data extraction using fieldInfo()?

This way:
EX1.Info<- fieldInfo(mosaic = EX1.Indices, fieldShape = EX1.Shape$fieldShape) 
EX1.Info$fieldShape@data

And not this way:
EX1.Info<- fieldInfo(mosaic = EX1.Indices[[c("Index_Name")]], fieldShape = EX1.Shape$fieldShape) 
EX1.Info$fieldShape@data

Best,
Filipe
